name: Local Falcon
description: Local Falcon gives Claude access to real-time local search data across Google Maps, Apple Maps, and AI search platforms. With 37 tools spanning geo-grid rank tracking, competitor intelligence, campaign management, Google Business Profile monitoring, and AI search visibility tracking, Claude becomes a full-service local search and AI visibility analyst.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Local Falcon to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Local Falcon to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.localfalcon.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Local Falcon MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Local Falcon lists 37 MCP tools, including listLocalFalconScanReports, getLocalFalconReport, runLocalFalconScan, listLocalFalconCampaignReports, getLocalFalconCampaignReport, createLocalFalconCampaign, runLocalFalconCampaign, pauseLocalFalconCampaign, resumeLocalFalconCampaign, reactivateLocalFalconCampaign, listLocalFalconTrendReports, and getLocalFalconTrendReport.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Local Falcon?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Local Falcon in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.

_published_faq.name: Does Local Falcon MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Local Falcon requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Local Falcon is developed by Local Falcon. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
